lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p22 - Listen, point & say

details: Listen, Point and Say checks understanding of word meaning and sound. Listen and point shows they match what they hear to the right image. Say practises first-step pronunciation.
Look for careful listening, correct pointing, clear sounds, and confident repetition.

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p22 - 3. Sort the chicken, cow and duck

details: Sort the chicken, cow and duck checks understanding of animal vocabulary and anatomy as students group the chicken, cow, and duck correctly into groups of two legs and four legged animals.
Look for correct sorting into two and four-legged groups, recognition of each animal, and appropriate placement.

lessonPlan.topic: Activity Book p68 - Cut, sort and stick

details: Cut, sort and stick prepares students for freer practice of the target language by placing the cut out animals in the home or the barn. Sorting reinforces comprehension of where animals naturally belong. Stick aids fine motor skills, improving hand-eye co-ordination and developing precision.
Look for correct handling of scissors and careful cutting out, sorting into correct domestic and non-domestic categories pictorially and the ability to direct the glue where intended.
